entries.title: Participants in the order they were submitted
entries.summary: a new **Participant display order** on the Roles page (limited release — the lock beside **Add** says whether it is on for your event) shows every participant on a session in one list, in the order the submitter listed them, with role badges; roles themselves drag to reorder, and reports sort by the same **Display order**. Submissions already in your event keep the order they were entered in on the form.

enable.path: Program → Settings → Roles — the lock beside Add says whether it is on

where.path: Program → Settings → Roles; session Participants tab; Report Builder → Display order

entries.use_case: Medical and scientific programs care about author order: the submitter's order is the order on the poster, the abstract book and the citation. This keeps that order everywhere without the organizer re-sorting by hand.

cs_action.note: Flag per event. Existing submissions keep the order they were entered on the form.

internal.staff_path: Admin Settings → Event → Features → Participant ordering
internal.when_to_bring_up: Abstract-heavy programs, any customer who asks why co-authors appear in the wrong order, anyone exporting an abstract book.
internal.who_should_get_it: Medical/scientific societies; associations with multi-author submissions.
internal.gotchas: Roles still drag to reorder separately; reports sort by Display order, not role.

entries.title: Role Attributes
entries.summary: define Text, Textarea and Dropdown attributes per participant role on a new **Attributes** tab of the Roles page (Enterprise, alongside Speaker Affiliations), fill them in on each session's Participants tab, and have submission forms collect them next to affiliations with the **Collect role attributes** switch; each attribute is a sortable column on participant contacts in the Report Builder.

enable.path: Program → Settings → Roles → Attributes tab (Enterprise, beside Speaker Affiliations)

where.path: Program → Settings → Roles → Attributes; session Participants tab; forms → Collect role attributes

entries.use_case: Collect per-role facts (presenting author, disclosure status, honorarium tier) once, on the participant record, instead of as free-text session fields that cannot be reported on.

cs_action.note: Enterprise feature; enable alongside Speaker Affiliations.

internal.staff_path: Admin Settings → Event → Features → Role attributes
internal.when_to_bring_up: Customers tracking presenting author, CME disclosure or honorarium details per speaker; anyone who built custom session fields for per-person data.
internal.gotchas: Text, Textarea and Dropdown only; each attribute is a Report Builder column on participant contacts.

entries.title: CMS module in the organization sidebar
entries.summary: **Sites** and **Content Galleries** moved out of **Program → Build** into their own **CMS** module, in the same slot as the event CMS (Program, CRM, Marketing, CMS, Learning). Its Overview explains the four publishing surfaces and which ones are built per event.
entries.use_case: Sites and Content Galleries are now in one module at the org level, in the same slot as the event CMS, so the organization's publishing surfaces are findable without opening Program.

internal.when_to_bring_up: Customers asking where Sites went after the sidebar change.

entries.title: Notification settings from the bell
entries.summary: the settings icon in the top-right of the notifications menu opens Preferences for the organization or event you are in.
entries.use_case: Admins who feel over-notified can tune what they get right from the bell, instead of hunting for Preferences.

entries.title: Ballot step for Public voting rounds
entries.summary: the evaluation plan wizard gains a **Ballot** step whenever a round uses Public voting. Add submissions to the ballot from the whole plan scope, by submission filters, or one by one, and remove any that have not been voted on yet; a plan whose rounds are all Public voting goes straight from Rounds to Ballot. Random ballots are no longer dealt from an empty round, and voters whose random subset is short are dealt submissions added later, even after voting has started. **Reset ballots** gives way to a dealt/votes notice once a vote exists. Works on event plans and Interest Form plans.

enable.path: Evaluation plan wizard → Ballot step appears once a round uses Public voting

entries.use_case: Community voting (choose-the-program, people's choice) needs control over what is on the ballot. Organizers pick submissions from the whole plan, by filter, or one by one, and random ballots are dealt from a real pool.

cs_action.note: Customers already running public votes should re-check their ballot after this change.

internal.when_to_bring_up: Any customer doing audience/community voting or people's choice awards.
internal.who_should_get_it: Events with public voting rounds; Interest Form plans.
internal.gotchas: Reset ballots is replaced by a dealt/votes notice once a vote exists.

entries.title: Title slides inside speakers' presentations, and a check for stale ones
entries.summary: after a Slides run, download any single session's deck or attach the decks to sessions without generating again. **Program → Files** is now **Presentations & files**, with filters by file type, session status, submission status and title-slide state, and an **Add title slide to presentations…** action that writes a *(with title slide)* copy of each selected PDF or PowerPoint with the branded title slide at the start, end or both — originals untouched. Every generated slide and merged copy is marked **Out of date** when the session or template changes afterwards, with the reasons and a one-click **Regenerate**.

where.path: Program → Presentations & files → Add title slide to presentations…

entries.use_case: The AV team gets every speaker's deck with a branded title slide already in it, and Sessionboard flags decks that went stale when the session or template changed — no more re-exporting the whole program the night before.

internal.when_to_bring_up: Pre-event, when a customer talks about speaker-ready rooms, AV hand-off or slide templates.
internal.who_should_get_it: Any event collecting presentations; conferences with an AV vendor.
internal.gotchas: Writes a '(with title slide)' copy; originals untouched. PDF and PowerPoint only.

entries.title: Design title slides in Sessionboard
entries.summary: Slides now starts from six branded designs built from your brand kit and session roles, with a live preview on your real sessions. Choose which participant groups appear and in what order (moderators first, say), how many fit, and which details print under each name; export editable PowerPoint slides or Letter and A4 cover pages, with an optional end slide.

where.path: Marketing → Slides (also Sessions list → Create → Slides)

entries.use_case: Six branded designs from the brand kit, previewed on real sessions, exported as editable PowerPoint or print cover pages — a designer's day of work for a holding-slide deck is now a few clicks.

internal.when_to_bring_up: Customers who ask for 'walk-in slides', holding slides or session title cards; onboarding Marketing.

entries.title: The unread dot on list rows explains itself
entries.summary: the red dot beside a session, contact, sponsor, exhibitor or person in a list marks unread messages, notes or activity, not an error. Hover it to see what is waiting and click it to open the record on the tab that has the unread item.

where.path: Sessions, Contacts, Sponsors, Exhibitors lists → red dot on a row

entries.use_case: Admins read the red dot as an error. Hovering now says what is unread, and clicking opens the record on the tab that has it.

internal.when_to_bring_up: Support tickets about 'red dots I cannot clear'.

entries.title: Download a blank copy of any form
entries.summary: **Download Form** on submission, application, portal, intake, interest and awards forms saves the form as a PDF or Word document, with every question, section, description and choice laid out in order, including conditional questions, each noted with when it shows.

where.path: Any form → Download Form (PDF or Word)

entries.use_case: Committees review the questions offline, IT and legal sign off on what is asked, and speakers who want to draft in Word before submitting get the real form — including conditional questions and when they show.

internal.when_to_bring_up: Any 'can you send me the questions' request; committee review of the CFP; accessibility accommodations.
